title: OMGS hunter candidates
description: Machine-readable hunter handoff contract. Candidates are hypotheses, not confirmed findings, and never carry severity. This is the agent handoff shape, not the CLI findings schema.

hunter.description: Identity of the hunter that raised this candidate. The verifier that decides it must be someone else.

attack_class.description: Prefer the shared intent/classes.json registry. Stable lowercase extension identifiers remain allowed; they never remove ledger accountability.

entry_point.description: Repo-relative path plus HTTP method/route or exported action symbol.

sink.description: Repo-relative module and stable effect-producing symbol.

boundary.description: Principal/resource boundary and invariant allegedly violated.

attacker_capability.description: Lowest privilege, controlled inputs, required state.

trace.description: Ordered input, enforcement checks, sink, and returned data or mutation, with source references.

concrete_result.description: Specific disclosure, state change, or privileged local effect; distinguish predicted from observed.

counterevidence.description: Shared guards, backend policy, middleware, wrappers, and legitimate intent already checked.

missing_fact.description: Exact undecided fact; null when none.

intent_question.description: Plain-language question when intent matters; null when none.

proof_plan.description: Minimum synthetic fixture, safe invariant assertion, expected vulnerable failure and control success, local prerequisites, and stop condition.

fingerprint.description: Output of omgs fingerprint over attack_class, entry_point, sink, boundary.
